type.description:
Incoming calls are intercepted.
 * `INTERCEPT_ALL` - Incoming calls are intercepted.
 * `ALLOW_ALL` - Incoming calls are not intercepted.

voicemailEnabled.description: Enabled or disabled state of sending incoming calls to voicemail when the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

announcements.description: Settings related to how incoming calls are handled when the intercept feature is enabled.
